strings.gate.lead: Wybierz, gdzie głównie mieszkasz. To ustawia powiadomienia o prywatności, język interfejsu i reguły funkcji. Nie używamy GPS ani IP do wykrywania lokalizacji.

strings.onboarding.title: Welcome to Rianell
strings.onboarding.aiDownload.body: Pobierz the AI model for summaries, note suggestions, and daily quotes. Wi-Fi recommended.

strings.onboarding.sessionRecording.body: To help improve Rianell, session recording (Smartlook, EU) is turned on by default. It collects anonymised heatmaps and error data-not individual reviews of your health entries. You can turn this off now or anytime in Settings → Privacy.

strings.settings.privacy.sessionRecording.consen: Smartlook may record how you use Rianell, including screens that show health data you have entered. Recordings are stored by Smartlook in the EU. You can turn this off at any time in Settings → Privacy.

strings.policy.global-baseline.title: Global privacy baseline
strings.policy.global-baseline.summary: Rianell stores health logs on your device by default. Cloud backup, anonymised research contribution, and on-device AI are optional and require separate consent. You can Eksportuj or Usuń your data at any time.
strings.policy.eu-gdpr.title: EEA & UK - GDPR
strings.policy.eu-gdpr.summary: Health data is special-category data under GDPR Art. 9. We rely on your explicit consent to process it locally and for optional cloud, research, and AI features. You have rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, and objection.
strings.policy.data-subject-rights.title: Your data rights
strings.policy.data-subject-rights.summary: You may Pobierz a Kopiuj of your health logs, request correction, withdraw consent, or Usuń local and cloud data from Ustawienia. Contact the operator for formal data-subject requests.
strings.policy.other-jurisdictions-us-ca.title: California (CCPA/CPRA)
strings.policy.other-jurisdictions-us-ca.summary: We do not sell personal information. California residents have rights to know, Usuń, and correct personal information. Health logs are consumer wellness data, not HIPAA-covered provider records unless you use Rianell under a healthcare BAA.
strings.policy.other-jurisdictions-us.title: United States - other states
strings.policy.other-jurisdictions-us.summary: Consumer wellness self-tracking is generally outside HIPAA unless you are a covered entity or business associate. State privacy laws may grant access and deletion rights similar to our global baseline.
strings.policy.other-jurisdictions-au.title: Australia
strings.policy.other-jurisdictions-au.summary: Australian Privacy Principles apply to personal information we hold. You may access and correct your data and complain to the OAIC.
strings.policy.other-jurisdictions-br.title: Brazil (LGPD)
strings.policy.other-jurisdictions-br.summary: LGPD grants confirmation, access, correction, anonymisation, portability, deletion, and information about sharing. Health data may receive heightened protection.

strings.tutorial.slide0.body: Czy chcesz korzystać z analizy AI (wzorce, wglądy, podsumowania) oraz celów? Możesz włączyć to później w Ustawieniach.
strings.tutorial.slide1.body: Śledź zdrowie codziennie: zapisuj objawy, jedzenie, ćwiczenia, obszary bólu i więcej w jednym miejscu.
strings.tutorial.slide8.body: Optional cycle tracking on step 1 of the log wizard records cycle day, phase, and flow. Rianell can suggest your phase from your last entry and today's date.
strings.tutorial.slide8.hint: You can change this anytime in Ustawienia → Data options.
strings.tutorial.slide2.body: View Logs shows your history. AI Analysis finds patterns and correlations across your data.
strings.tutorial.slide3.body: W Ustawieniach możesz utworzyć konto, aby zapisać dane zaszyfrowane w chmurze i synchronizować między urządzeniami.
strings.tutorial.slide3.openData: Use open data for training AI - when on, AI uses open shared data; when off, AI uses only your personal data. Used for personalised AI analysis and advice.
strings.tutorial.slide3.accountBody: Utwórz konto, aby zapisać dane zaszyfrowane w chmurze i synchronizować między urządzeniami.
strings.tutorial.slide4.anonHint: Udostępnij zanonimizowane dane, aby pomóc ulepszać modele AI
strings.tutorial.slide4.openDataHint: Use anonymised data pool for AI training (requires 90+ days of data). Used for personalised AI analysis and advice.
strings.tutorial.slide5.body: Opcje dostępności ułatwiają czytanie i korzystanie z aplikacji od pierwszego dnia. Możesz je zmienić później w Ustawienia → Dostępność.
strings.tutorial.slide5.largeTextHint: Quick preset for bigger text across the app.
strings.tutorial.slide5.ttsHint: Tap buttons/controls to hear their label read aloud.
strings.tutorial.slide5.readModeHint: Also reads when a control gets focus (keyboard and assistive navigation).
strings.tutorial.slide6.body: Ustaw cele i wartości docelowe przyciskiem obok Ustawień. Wybierz dzienne cele kroków, nawodnienia, oceny snu i dobrych dni w tygodniu.
strings.tutorial.slide6.progress: Your progress and "Last 7 days vs targets" appear on the Home tab so you can see how you're doing.
strings.tutorial.slide7.body: Wszystko gotowe. Zamknij, aby zacząć rejestrować, wypróbuj tryb demo lub utwórz konto, aby zapisać dane w chmurze.
strings.common.consent.healthDataBody: Rianell stores symptom and wellness logs on your device. This is special-category health data under GDPR. By continuing, you give explicit consent (Art. 9(2)(a)) to process health data locally to provide the app. Cloud backup, anonymized contribution, and on-device AI require separate toggles.
strings.common.consent.healthDataContact: Contact: jan.andersson@rianell.com. See our privacy policy for your rights.
strings.common.read.mode.focus.hint: When on: focused controls are also read aloud (keyboard and assistive navigation).
strings.settings.accessibility.plainLanguageHint: When on: AI summaries use simpler words (B1 level). Your log notes are never rewritten.
strings.settings.accessibility.chartPaletteHint: Chart colours are separate from the app theme.
